name: solace-agentic-chats
description: Local-first hub where multiple AI coding agents (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Qwen, ...) work on the same project and can talk to each other.

scripts.//start: `npm start` is the documented way to run Solace. It was `npm run dev`, which was actively misleading: "dev" reads as development mode, and running the app is what everybody does - contributors and users alike. `dev` is kept below as an alias so anyone used to it, and any existing doc or script, still works.
scripts.//prestart: packages/server imports @solace/shared from its BUILT dist, so a clone that has never run a build cannot start the server: it died with MODULE_NOT_FOUND for @solace/shared while the web dev server came up fine, leaving a new user looking at a UI that could never reach a backend. npm runs prestart automatically, so the one documented command works on a fresh clone. It costs ~2s on every later start, which is the right trade against a broken first run.
scripts.//pretest: Same reason as predev: the server test suite imports @solace/shared and mass-fails without dist, which reads as dozens of unrelated broken tests.
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/server && npm run build --workspace=packages/web
